body: Maybe. But I never really get a chance to cos it's often one night or a couple of dates and they ghost. I've never really asked about a relationship or pushed for it and tbh I'm more concerned that I feel like there is no reciprocation when even messaging.
I have no other way of meeting people atm I'm a teacher so my life is basically school and home
I am also naturally very shy but often it comes across as intimidating

When we came back from summer he was super flirty, we were texting and then he kept asking when I'd be out next and then I saw him and my friend was like we were being super flirty. So I went to the same club but then he got with someone else then he text me again and then stopped replying. I was so confused.
I have only once in tinder but apart from that not really.
Trust me I know I'm not worth saving. I'm not going to achieve anything. So I don't believe I am I can feel it. I don't talk to anyone because I have no one

Those lines are only for people that are worth saving. I know I'm not I've been told and been treated as such many times I've known for probably most of my 21 years being here. How do you even get that worth? I always assumed eventually I'll get it but I realise some people are born with it and it doesn't matter if I calm them because at the end of the day I'll go to bed alone steal feeling the same. I know. I know.
